title: Publish a paid listing (owner action)
goal: Make the product buyable by a stranger.
measurable_target: 1 public listing with a working paid checkout and the zip attached.
deliverable: Public listing URL (itch.io recommended: free account, no listing fee) recorded in this mission's evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Listing is public and shows price, description and real screenshots
Checkout works for a logged-out visitor (open the page in a private window)
The uploaded file is the zip built by tools/build.py
Listing text matches marketing/product-description.md and makes no unverified claims
landing-page/index.html CTA link points to the listing
human_steps: Create a free itch.io account yourself (the system never creates accounts).
Set up payouts in itch.io (PayPal or Stripe) - your decision, your details; never paste them here.
New project -> Kind: Tools / Assets; upload the zip; price e.g. $14 (see marketing/pricing.md).
Paste marketing/product-description.md; add screenshots from M001.
Publish, open in a private window to check the buy button, record the URL as evidence.
